title: UC6 loan 1 pending-approval schedule: the six observed principal components sum to the disbursed principal and amortize to zero (Tier-D MNT replay)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the pending-approval repayment schedule of UC6 loan 1 from the Tier-D MNT replay of LoanUpdateApprovedAmount.feature. This is the same candidate the pilot (F-2026-09-11-tierd-pilot-loan-refusal.md) transcribed in EUR and offered to the loan-schedule-amortization seam, where it was refused by the tenant_params equality rule because the replay tenant was EUR and PIN-loan.json is MNT. The 2026-09-11 driver decision re-seeded the disposable oracle to MNT (same two minor digits, ISO 4217 496 vs 978, so the arithmetic is identical) and replayed the same scenario; this vector is re-transcribed from the MNT capture. request.schedule_amortization transcribes periods[0].principalDisbursed 1000.0 -> "100000" and the six observed periods[1..6].principalDue values 164.26/165.21/166.18/167.15/168.12/169.08 raised to integer minor units. expect.principal_sum_minor and expect.final_principal_balance_minor are TRANSCRIPTIONS, not recomputations: the components sum to 100000 = the disbursed principal exactly, and periods[6].principalLoanBalanceOutstanding is 0.0, so the final balance is "0". Nothing was computed by this promotion.

provenance.note: request.schedule_amortization and both expected cells are transcribed from the committed MNT capture loan-1-detail-associations-all-1.json, the UC6 loan 1 read-back while status was loanStatusType.submitted.and.pending.approval, carrying currency.code MNT (decimalPlaces 2). capture_case_id names the loan's externalId fe61fc1a-87f2-4180-ad97-6116ed335c36, which appears in the capture's top-level externalId. TENANT `tierd` -- NOT tenant `gerege`. IMAGE sha256:e596339626bf...; scenario LoanUpdateApprovedAmount.feature UC6; Asia/Ulaanbaatar; rounding mode 4 (HALF_UP); instance destroyed.
